description: Core permissions for the splash window. The backend payload is spawned from Rust (not from JS), so no process-execute permission is exposed to the webview. The splash may listen for bootstrap://status progress events (core:event:default, within core:default), pull the latest status via bootstrap_status, and invoke the narrowly scoped retry_bootstrap command after a failed first-run payload download. The main window loads the loopback backend over HTTP, where Tauri IPC is disabled by default.
